scripts.build: npm run install-backend && npm run install-frontend && npm run build-frontend && npm run sync-frontend
scripts.vercel-build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r frontend/dist/* dist/
scripts.render-build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r frontend/dist/* dist/
scripts.sync-frontend: rm -rf backend/public dist && mkdir -p backend/public dist && cp -r frontend/dist/* backend/public/ && cp -r frontend/dist/* dist/
